messages:
Amy (support): customer-rep escalated at 09:26 UTC — rerank endpoint returning intermittent 504/502 under load. They say p95 latency jumped from ~200ms to 2s and ~12% 5xx on heavy re-ranks (large candidate lists). attaching repro notes.

Kate (cs): customer: 'saw this around 09:20, no client change on our side. We send candidate arrays ~500-2000 items for personalization step.'

Amy (support): repro we ran locally:
```
# sample repro
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"What restaurants...","candidates":["id1", "id2", ... up to 1000], "options":{"top_k":10}}'
```
Load test: 50 RPS for 5m, candidate_count=1000 -> observed ~10-15% 5xx, p95 ~2.5s.

Sam (sre): digging into infra metrics — gateway timeouts spike aligns exactly with customer burst windows. Gateway logs show retry storms (3 retries) amplified backend work. Backend pods return 502 with traces showing long fanout latency in the reranker stage. KV-cache miss rate jumps during bursts.

Javier (eng-runtime): any recent changes to batching/kvcache? I see a deploy at 09:15 that tweaked the batching window for continuous-batch (reduce latency for small requests). Could be interaction with very large candidate arrays.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: prod/rerank-service @ 2026-03-15T09:15:12Z — rev=abc123 — change="batching window tuned"

Sam (sre): logs snippet:
[proxy] 2026-03-15T09:21:03Z id=zzzz gateway 504 route=/v1/rerank latency=3000ms retries=3
[rerank-worker] 2026-03-15T09:21:03Z id=zzzz fanout_ms=1800 kvcache_misses=78 candidates=1024

Amy (support): customer agrees to run a test with chunked candidates and reduced concurrency. Trying chunk_size=200 first.

Kate (cs): customer status: running chunked test now, will report after 10m.

Sam (sre): quick mitigations we applied: 1) temporarily set route-level gateway retries=0 for /v1/rerank for this tenant; 2) added a soft per-tenant qps cap; 3) bumped rerank pool min replicas by +2. Early numbers look promising.

Sam (sre): note — disabling retries cut amplification. Before: each client retry produced parallel backend work; after: dropped 5xx from ~12% -> ~1.2% in initial sample window.

Amy (support): customer confirmation: p95 dropped from ~2.5s -> ~420ms after chunking + reduced retries, errors down. Thanks to SRE for the quick patch.

Javier (eng-runtime): hypothesis: the small batching-window change increased the chance that very large candidate requests are included in the same batch, creating a heavy synchronous fanout. When KV cache miss churn is high, one slow shard stalls the batch and triggers timeouts and retries. Repro plan:
- run synthetic with candidate_count=[100,200,500,1000,2000]
- vary batching_window=[10ms,30ms,50ms]
- collect flamegraphs, kernel selection logs, and kvcache hit/miss per shard

Sam (sre): I started a targeted repro harness on staging (job id: repro-rrank-180123) — will attach traces. Also collecting sample request ids for the 5xx set.

Infra Oncall: putting a temporary rule to block >1200 candidates per single request for production for next 24h while we root cause.

Kate (cs): customer accepted the temporary cap and appreciates the quick rollback. They requested ETA on permanent fix.

Javier (eng-runtime): next actions for eng-runtime team:
- add guardrails to split huge candidate arrays server-side into safe chunks
- add a backpressure signal instead of triggering full retries
- revisit batching-window revert if tests confirm regression

Sam (sre): my tasks:
- collect flamegraphs + perf counters (due EOD)
- provide trace ids and sample payloads to eng-runtime
- monitor after guard applied

Amy (support): my tasks:
- coordinate customer test for final verification
- confirm billing not impacted (they worried about duplicate billing due to retries)

Kate (cs): please also confirm no duplicate charge for retried requests; flagged billing.

Sam (sre): billing note — retries were idempotent at gateway level for this path, but we'll confirm logs and patch if any duplicates slipped through.

Javier (eng-runtime): I'll prioritize a server-side splitter and a canary rollback of batching-window. Expect a follow-up PR and canary in a few hours.

Amy (support): thanks team. tagging @javier @sam. I'll update customer with mitigations and next-steps.

Sam (sre): update 10:05 UTC — after route retry disable + cap, production stable: p95 back to ~400-600ms, 5xx <1.5%. continuing monitoring.

Amy (support): closing interim escalation; will reopen if customer sees regression. action items assigned. :white_check_mark:
